+def _is_empty_import_value(value: Any) -> bool:
+    if value is None:
+        return True
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return not value.strip() or value.strip() == '????'
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return not value or all(_is_empty_import_value(item) for item in value)
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        if set(value) == {'name'}:
+            return _is_empty_import_value(value.get('name'))
+        return not value
+    return False
+
+
+def supplement_rec_with_import_item_metadata(
+    rec: dict[str, Any], identifier: str
+) -> None:
+    """Fill missing import fields from a staged or pending item, in place."""
+    try:
+        from openlibrary.core.imports import ImportItem
+
+        item = ImportItem.find_staged_or_pending([identifier]).first()
+        if not item:
+            return
+        metadata = json.loads(item.get('data', '{}'))
+        for field in (
+            'authors', 'publish_date', 'publishers', 'number_of_pages',
+            'physical_format', 'isbn_10', 'isbn_13', 'title',
+        ):
+            if _is_empty_import_value(rec.get(field)) and not _is_empty_import_value(
+                metadata.get(field)
+            ):
+                rec[field] = metadata[field]
+    except Exception:
+        logger.exception('Unable to supplement import metadata for %s', identifier)
+
+
+def _augment_incomplete_record(rec: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    def is_missing(field: str) -> bool:
+        return _is_empty_import_value(rec.get(field))
+
+    if not any(is_missing(field) for field in ('title', 'authors', 'publish_date')):
+        return
+    identifiers = rec.get('identifiers') or {}
+    isbn_10 = rec.get('isbn_10') or identifiers.get('isbn_10')
+    if isinstance(isbn_10, list):
+        isbn_10 = next((value for value in isbn_10 if value), None)
+    asin_values = identifiers.get('amazon') or []
+    if isinstance(asin_values, str):
+        asin_values = [asin_values]
+    asin = next(
+        (
+            value
+            for value in asin_values
+            if value and value.upper().startswith('B')
+        ),
+        None,
+    )
+    if not asin:
+        asin = next(
+            (
+                source.split(':', 1)[1]
+                for source in rec.get('source_records', [])
+                if source.startswith('amazon:B')
+            ),
+            None,
+        )
+    identifier = isbn_10 or asin
+    if identifier:
+        supplement_rec_with_import_item_metadata(rec, identifier)
+
+
